definitions.explanation: The land along the edge of a body of water such as a river, lake, or sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{岸|きし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I moored the boat at the shore.
You can see houses on the other side of the river.
examples.notes: ⟦{向|む}こう→向こう：00971_mukou⟧{岸|きし} = the other shore/bank

examples.japanese: {岸|きし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{岸|きし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{釣|つ}っている→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧。
examples.english: The children are fishing on the shore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{泳|およ}いでいた→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{岸|きし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: I was swimming but got tired, so I returned to the shore.

notes:
{岸|きし} means shore, bank, or coast. It refers to the land at the edge of water.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {岸|きし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧ (to reach the shore)
- {岸|きし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧ (along the shore)
- {岸|きし}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧ (to leave the shore)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{向|む}こう→向こう：00971_mukou⟧{岸|きし} (the opposite shore/bank)
- ⟦{川岸|かわぎし}→川岸：24545_kawagishi⟧ (riverbank)
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧ (seashore, coast)
- ⟦{岸辺|きしべ}→岸辺：20225_kishibe⟧ (waterside, shore)
- ⟦{対岸|たいがん}→対岸：17100_taigan⟧ (opposite shore)

NOTE: {岸|きし} alone often refers to riverbanks; for seashore, ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧ is more specific.
